 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Mohamed Abdelmonem is not fit to play for OGC Nice when they host Paris Saint-Germain on Saturday afternoon. It is 'joker' signing, Alidu Seidu, who is expected to take his place in Olivier Pantaloni's defence later today.
 Abdelmonem is only a short-term absentee, but he joins more long-term absentees Moise Bombito, Antoine Mendy, and Laurent Abergel on the sidelines. Nice won't tinker with a winning formula, having won five of their last six. Their run of form since Matchday 5 has lifted them off the foot of the table and into the European qualifying places.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Elye Wahi has been a big part of Le Gym's recent success, and he will once again lead the line against the reigning champions, with Mohamed Amoura and Sofiane Diop either side of him.
 Nice likely line-up v PSG
 Yehvann Diouf; Xavier Mandza, Youssouf Ndayishimiye, Alidu Seidu; Niels Nkounkou, Hicham Boudaoui, Axel Witsel, Jonathan Clauss; Mohamed Amoura, Elye Wahi, Sofiane Diop. (L'Éq)
 GFFN | Luke Entwistle
